title: TOPN picks the rows with its own sort; ORDER BY then sorts the result
query: TOPN ( 2, ADDCOLUMNS ( VALUES ( Product[Product] ), "@Amt", [Sales Amount] ), [@Amt], DESC )

source.quote: TOPN does not choose the specified number of rows to return based on the sort order specified in ORDER BY.
source.supports: TOPN uses its own order expression

source.quote: ORDER BY only sorts the result table returned by TOPN.
source.supports: ORDER BY sorts what TOPN returned

source.quote: TOPN does not guarantee any sort order for the results.

derivation: Sales Amount by product: Bike 100 + 200 + 100 = 400, Helmet 40 + 20 = 60, Lock 50 + 30 = 80, Scooter BLANK. The top 2 descending are Bike and Lock. ORDER BY ascending then lists Lock 80 before Bike 400. If ORDER BY chose the rows, the two lowest would come back instead.
